data.display_address: Park Lane, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Park Lane, developed by Emaar, is a distinguished residential project situated in the vibrant Dubai Hills neighborhood. This development features a modern architectural design that harmoniously integrates with the serene environment of Dubai Hills Estate. Each building is a masterful blend of elegance and functionality, with every detail thoughtfully designed to highlight artistic beauty and contemporary innovation.

The complex presents an exquisite variety of living spaces, including 3-bedroom townhouses and 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, each catering to a variety of preferences and lifestyles. Designed with attention to detail and style, the residences overlook a beautifully landscaped podium, giving residents views of elegant outdoor spaces and state-of-the-art amenities.

Park Lane is home to an array of unique amenities. There are equipped gyms, swimming pools, children's play areas and a barbecue area.

The complex is strategically located. Opposite is Dubai Hills Park, which includes wadi paths, a children's play park, sports facilities and a gym. Dubai Hills Mall and Dubai Hills Golf Club are in close proximity. Downtown Dubai can be reached in 12 minutes, Dubai Marina in 15 minutes and Dubai International Airport is 20 minutes away.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
